protocol.augmentation: paired h/v flips + right-angle rotations; classification random crop after resize1.12x

hyperparameters.batch_norm: physical microbatch statistics, not physical batch64
hyperparameters.lr_schedule: linear warmup 3 actual epochs; linear decay to lr0*0.01 at planned epoch150
hyperparameters.tail_policy: flush every epoch, normalize accumulated gradients by actual sample count
hyperparameters.test_policy: one final evaluation of earliest best validation EMA checkpoint

protocol.source_reused: frozen networks, transforms and metric functions only; old campaign training never invoked
protocol.supervision: ground-truth supervised; not comparable with transductive unsupervised CD literature
